`UniqueFactorizationMonoid` is a class parametrized over `[CancelCommMonoidWithZero α]`; the produced statement only assumes `[CommMonoidWithZero M]`, which is insufficient to even state `[UniqueFactorizationMonoid M]` on M.

Weakens/changes the ambient algebraic structure from `CommSemiring` (gold, matching the additive+multiplicative structure needed for ring localization) to `CommMonoidWithZero` (produced), dropping the additive structure entirely.

Loses generality: gold states the result for an arbitrary localization N (any CommSemiring N with [Algebra M N] [IsLocalization S N]), while produced only states it for the specific canonical `Localization S` construction.
Drops the `Algebra M N` and `IsLocalization S N` hypotheses present in gold, along with the general target type N, replacing them with a concrete (and malformed) instantiation.
